exam.title: Session 3 — SQL Practice
exam.description: Validated practice set for SQL Query Fundamentals, using the production question banks linked to Session3.pptx.

questions.question: Which statement about SQL keyword case is supported by Session 3?

options.text: SQL keywords must always be lowercase.
SELECT and select are different commands.
SELECT and select have the same meaning as SQL keywords.

explanation.ar: المادة بتوضح إن SQL keywords نفسها case insensitive، فـ SELECT وselect ليهم نفس المعنى كأوامر SQL.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of a semicolon in SQL according to the session?

options.text: To separate SQL statements, especially when multiple statements are sent in one call.
To create a primary key automatically.

explanation.ar: الـ semicolon هو الفاصل القياسي بين SQL statements، خصوصًا لما النظام يسمح بتنفيذ أكتر من statement في نفس الطلب.

questions.question: What does SELECT * FROM customers; request?

options.text: Only rows where age is greater than 30.
All columns from the customers table.

explanation.ar: النجمة * مع SELECT معناها اختيار كل الأعمدة من الجدول المحدد في FROM.

source.reference: Slide 13 — SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY basics

questions.question: In a basic SELECT query, what is the role of FROM?

options.text: It identifies the table from which data is retrieved.

explanation.ar: FROM بتحدد الجدول اللي الاستعلام هيقرأ منه البيانات.

questions.question: What does DISTINCT do in a SELECT query?

options.text: It deletes duplicate rows from the table permanently.
It returns only distinct values or rows from the selected output.

explanation.ar: DISTINCT بتأثر على نتيجة الاستعلام فقط وبتشيل التكرار من الـ output، مش من البيانات المخزنة.

questions.question: What does DESC mean when used with ORDER BY?

options.text: Delete rows from the bottom of a table.

explanation.ar: DESC اختصار descending وبيخلي الترتيب من الأكبر للأصغر أو من Z لـ A حسب نوع البيانات.

source.reference: Slide 13 — ORDER BY age DESC, name ASC

questions.question: Which DDL statement is listed as creating an index (search key)?

explanation.ar: Session 3 بتذكر CREATE INDEX صراحة كـ DDL لإنشاء index أو search key.

questions.question: What does DROP TABLE do according to Session 3?

options.text: Sorts the table by its primary key.

explanation.ar: DROP TABLE من أوامر DDL وبيحذف الجدول نفسه، مش مجرد صف واحد.

questions.question: Which command is used to update existing rows?

explanation.ar: UPDATE هو أمر تعديل البيانات الموجودة بالفعل، وSession 3 بتعرض UPDATE ... SET ... WHERE ضمن CRUD.

questions.question: What is the risk of omitting WHERE from an UPDATE or DELETE, according to the session?

options.text: The statement can affect all rows.
The query becomes a SELECT statement.
Only the first row is affected.

explanation.ar: المادة بتنبه إن غياب WHERE في UPDATE أو DELETE ممكن يخلي العملية تطبق على كل الصفوف، ودي نقطة troubleshooting مهمة.

questions.question: The Students example has columns LastName and FirstName. Which query returns exactly those two columns?

options.text: SELECT * FROM Students WHERE LastName, FirstName;
SELECT DISTINCT * FROM Students ORDER BY FirstName;

explanation.ar: المثال في الشرائح 14–15 بيستخدم SELECT LastName, FirstName FROM Students لاختيار عمودين محددين.

questions.question: In the Students DISTINCT example, the City values are Puerto Princesa, Quezon, and Quezon. What does SELECT DISTINCT City return?

explanation.ar: DISTINCT بيحتفظ بكل قيمة مختلفة مرة واحدة، لذلك Quezon المتكررة بتظهر مرة واحدة فقط.

questions.question: Using the sample customers in Slide 22, how many customers satisfy WHERE age > 30?

explanation.ar: الأعمار الأكبر من 30 هي 34 و41 و33 و45 و31 و36، يعني 6 صفوف.

source.reference: Slides 22–23 — sample customers and WHERE age > 30

questions.question: Using the sample customers, which customer appears first under ORDER BY age DESC, name ASC?

explanation.ar: أكبر age في البيانات هو 45 لفهد، لذلك يظهر أولًا مع DESC.

questions.question: Using the sample customers, what count does GROUP BY city produce for Riyadh?

explanation.ar: Riyadh موجودة مع Ali Hassan وFahad Zayed، لذلك COUNT(*) للمجموعة يساوي 2.

source.reference: Slides 22 and 24 — sample data / GROUP BY city

questions.question: Using the sample customers, what is AVG(age) for the Riyadh group?

explanation.ar: أعمار Riyadh هي 29 و45، والمتوسط (29+45)/2 = 37.

source.reference: Slides 19 and 22 — AVG(age) by city / sample data

questions.question: What row is targeted by UPDATE customers SET email = ... WHERE customer_id = 5;?

options.text: Only the row whose customer_id equals 5.
The fifth column of every row.

explanation.ar: WHERE customer_id = 5 بيحدد الصف صاحب المفتاح 5 فقط؛ رقم 5 هنا قيمة row identifier مش رقم عمود.

questions.question: What does DELETE FROM customers WHERE email = 'noura.salem@example.com'; do?

options.text: Removes rows whose email matches that value.
Changes the matching email to NULL.

explanation.ar: DELETE FROM ... WHERE بيحذف الصفوف المطابقة للشرط، مش الجدول نفسه ولا العمود.

questions.question: In the customers table definition, which constraint prevents the same email value from being stored more than once?

explanation.ar: UNIQUE على email هو القيد المخصص لمنع تكرار نفس القيمة في هذا العمود.

questions.question: The customers table has CHECK (age BETWEEN 0 AND 120). Which attempted age violates the rule?

explanation.ar: BETWEEN 0 AND 120 بيحدد المجال المقبول؛ 125 خارجه وبالتالي يخرق CHECK.

questions.question: A MySQL table is stored with a specific table name spelling. What caution does Session 3 give?

options.text: All SQL keywords must match table-name case.
Use the table name as it exists in the database because MySQL may distinguish table-name case.
Column values are always case sensitive.
SELECT must be written in uppercase or it fails.

explanation.ar: المادة بتفرق بين SQL keywords اللي case insensitive وبين table names في MySQL اللي لازم تتكتب زي ما هي موجودة.

questions.question: Which pair correctly contrasts DDL and DML examples from Session 3?

options.text: GROUP BY changes structure; DROP TABLE sorts rows.
SELECT DISTINCT creates a database; UPDATE creates an index.
CREATE TABLE changes structure; INSERT INTO adds data.
INSERT INTO drops a table; ORDER BY alters a database.

explanation.ar: CREATE TABLE من DDL لإنشاء structure، بينما INSERT INTO من DML لإضافة بيانات.

questions.question: In CREATE TABLE customers, which column is explicitly defined as the PRIMARY KEY?

explanation.ar: الكود في Slide 21 بيعرّف customer_id كـ INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY.

questions.question: A second customer is inserted with an email already present in the table. Which part of the Session 3 schema is intended to stop that?

options.text: SELECT DISTINCT in a later query.

explanation.ar: SELECT DISTINCT يعالج تكرار الـ output فقط، لكن منع duplicate email وقت التخزين مسؤولية UNIQUE constraint.

questions.question: What happens if an INSERT attempts to store NULL in customers.name under the shown schema?

options.text: It automatically becomes an empty string.
It violates the NOT NULL constraint on name.
It is allowed because name has no constraint.

explanation.ar: name معرف بـ VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL، وبالتالي NULL غير مسموح في العمود.

questions.question: Which query best matches the requirement “return name and age for customers older than 30”?

options.text: SELECT * FROM customers ORDER BY age > 30;
SELECT name, age FROM customers WHERE age > 30;

explanation.ar: المطلوب اختيار عمودين ثم فلترة الصفوف، وده يتحقق بـ SELECT name, age ... WHERE age > 30.

questions.question: What does ORDER BY age DESC, name ASC mean?

options.text: Sort names descending first, then ignore age.
Sort by age descending first; for equal ages, sort names ascending.
Filter ages descending and names ascending.
Group rows by age and then delete duplicate names.

explanation.ar: ORDER BY بيطبّق مفاتيح الترتيب بالترتيب المكتوب: age DESC أولًا ثم name ASC عند التعادل.

source.reference: Slide 13 — ORDER BY age DESC, name ASC

questions.question: A query uses SELECT DISTINCT city FROM customers. Which statement is correct?

options.text: Repeated city values are returned once in the query result.
Repeated city rows are permanently deleted.
The city column becomes UNIQUE automatically.
Rows are sorted by city descending automatically.

explanation.ar: DISTINCT يغير result set فقط؛ لا يحذف بيانات ولا ينشئ constraint.

questions.question: Which query pattern is used in the session to count customers per city?

options.text: SELECT DISTINCT COUNT city WITHOUT GROUP BY.
SELECT city, COUNT(*) ... GROUP BY city.

explanation.ar: COUNT(*) مع GROUP BY city بيحسب عدد الصفوف داخل كل مجموعة مدينة.

source.reference: Slides 19 and 24 — COUNT customers per city

questions.question: Why does the session recommend avoiding SELECT * in production?

options.text: SELECT * cannot read tables with primary keys.
It recommends specifying the needed columns instead.

explanation.ar: Slide 26 بتعتبر SELECT * pitfall في production وبتوصي باختيار الأعمدة المطلوبة صراحة.

questions.question: Using the Slide 22 sample data, a query applies WHERE age > 30 and then ORDER BY age DESC. Which first three names are returned?

options.text: Omar Khalid, Fahad Zayed, Sara Ahmed.
Fahad Zayed, Sara Ahmed, Yousef Nabil.
Fahad Zayed, Omar Khalid, Hani Mansour.
Maya Haddad, Leila Faris, Ali Hassan.

explanation.ar: بعد فلترة age > 30 يبقى 6 عملاء، وترتيبهم تنازليًا يبدأ 45 ثم 41 ثم 36: Fahad ثم Omar ثم Hani.

source.reference: Slides 22–23 — sample data / WHERE and ORDER BY

questions.question: Using the sample data, GROUP BY city followed by ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC puts which city first?

options.text: All cities tie with one row.

explanation.ar: Riyadh هي المدينة الوحيدة المتكررة مرتين؛ باقي المدن مرة واحدة، فبتتصدر عند ترتيب COUNT(*) تنازليًا.

questions.question: A developer runs UPDATE customers SET city = 'Cairo'; and intended to change only one customer. What is the best diagnosis?

options.text: The command is DDL and will drop the table.
A GROUP BY clause is required for every UPDATE.
The missing WHERE clause can update every row.

explanation.ar: المشكلة الأساسية هي عدم وجود WHERE، والمادة تحذر إنه ممكن يؤثر على كل الصفوف.

questions.question: A team must change the email only for customer_id 7. Which approach best follows the session’s safe CRUD pattern?

options.text: Use UPDATE without WHERE and rely on row order.
Use DROP TABLE then recreate the table.

explanation.ar: الـ safe pattern هو تحديد الصف المطلوب بوضوح في WHERE مع UPDATE، زي المثال في Slide 25.

questions.question: Which query best implements “show customers older than 30, displaying name and age, oldest first”?

options.text: SELECT name, age FROM customers GROUP BY age > 30;
DELETE FROM customers WHERE age > 30 ORDER BY age DESC;
SELECT DISTINCT age > 30 FROM customers UPDATE age DESC;
SELECT name, age FROM customers WHERE age > 30 ORDER BY age DESC;

explanation.ar: المطلوب يجمع projection + filtering + sorting: SELECT الأعمدة، WHERE للشرط، وORDER BY DESC للترتيب.

source.reference: Slides 12–13 — SQL building blocks and examples

questions.question: Assume email is UNIQUE. After inserting one row with email x@example.com, a DELETE with WHERE email = 'x@example.com' succeeds. At most how many rows can that DELETE remove because of that email condition?

explanation.ar: UNIQUE يمنع وجود أكتر من صف بنفس email، لذلك شرط مساواة على القيمة دي يطابق بحد أقصى صف واحد.

source.reference: Slides 21 and 25 — UNIQUE email / DELETE by email

questions.question: Which sequence correctly maps the CRUD-style actions shown in Session 3?

options.text: INSERT → CREATE INDEX → GROUP BY → DROP DATABASE.
SELECT DISTINCT → ALTER DATABASE → HAVING → COMMIT.
DELETE → CREATE TABLE → SELECT → DROP INDEX only.

explanation.ar: Session 3 بتميز إنشاء الـ structure بـ CREATE TABLE، ثم إدخال البيانات INSERT، تعديلها UPDATE، وحذف صفوف DELETE.

questions.question: A developer wants a search key without changing row values. Which Session 3 DDL command is the best fit?

explanation.ar: CREATE INDEX هو أمر DDL المخصص لإنشاء index/search key، وده لا يعني تعديل قيم الصفوف نفسها.

questions.question: A duplicate email insert fails under the sample customers schema. Which fix best respects the intended design?

options.text: Replace the email column with SELECT *.
Insert a different email value rather than removing the UNIQUE constraint just to allow duplication.
Remove WHERE clauses from future UPDATE statements.

explanation.ar: المادة بتستخدم UNIQUE لمنع duplicate emails وبتعتبر عدم التعامل مع duplicates pitfall؛ الأفضل تصحيح البيانات بدل كسر القيد المقصود.

questions.question: Starting from the Slide 22 sample data, suppose customer_id 5 belongs to Yousef Nabil. The email is updated to noura.salem@example.com and then the shown DELETE removes rows with that email. What happens to that customer row?

options.text: It is removed by the DELETE because its email now matches the condition.
It remains because UPDATE prevents DELETE.
Only the email value is removed while the row remains.

explanation.ar: بعد UPDATE قيمة email للصف 5 تبقى القيمة اللي DELETE بيدور عليها، وبالتالي DELETE يحذف الصف المطابق.

source.reference: Slide 25 — Update email then delete by email
